set.body:
Outcome

Replace FeatureSet and FeatureSetPlan with one typed measurement model.

Acceptance

- Hard selections, weighted regions, and fixed projections are linear legs from an exact neural axis.
- Learned PCA, alignment, whitening, or feature selection cannot enter a frame until fitted and frozen with an authorized-sample receipt.
- Measurement identity includes exact support and weights; rendition metadata is separate and typed.
- Frame ordering is deterministic and does not alter measurement identity.
set.title: P1.5: implement fixed and frozen Measurement legs and MeasurementFrame
